in_sanskrit.name: Kota
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Fort, Hill, Fortress
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kota एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kutah’, meaning a fort, hill or fortress. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as Kota or Kotaraja, meaning the king of the fort.

in_hindi.long_meaning: The place where protection is offered or where people live in a community.
